exceptions.justification: TanStack Router's CLI writes this header into routeTree.gen.ts on every run; the file is generated, never hand-edited.
exceptions.ruleBroken: Every ESLint suppression names its rule and says why.
exceptions.attempted: Looked for a generator option to emit named, described suppressions instead of the fixed header.
exceptions.constraint: The generator writes the header itself; there is no option for it, and the file is overwritten whenever routes change.
exceptions.whyPreferable: Ignoring the file in the lint and type config is a second place to keep in sync and would drop this record's review.
exceptions.residualRisk: None for the shipped package: the file is part of an example app and is regenerated.
exceptions.revisitWhen: The router generator supports a configurable header, or the example stops using generated routes.
